notes.title: The Lancaster Leak Entity Exam - Back Up!
notes.content:
Changes:

New opt-out of webcam and computer profile utilization. A few players were concerned about this feature so it has now been made optional. Sorry for any confusion.

Image Overhaul:
New analog images to replace the old ones. These fit the theme of the game better.

Thank you for your patience during this downtime. It was important these issues were addressed.
